items.description:
Bamolapisi Construction and Plant Services is a home-building specialist based at The Boardwalk office park in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, with over a decade of experience designing and constructing quality homes. The company offers in-house architectural design alongside start-to-finish home construction, taking a project from site preparation and foundations through to roofing, finishes and handover.

It has helped homeowners across Gauteng and Mpumalanga turn their visions into real spaces, with a focus on reliable timelines, honest communication and homes built to last. The business can take on a project from scratch or step in to help finalise an existing design, offering a free quote to get started. It suits homeowners planning a new build who want one team to manage both the architecture and the construction, and the office is at Office G51 in The Boardwalk, Faerie Glen.

items.reason: Own site returned only a bot-challenge screen on every page, and search results were generic battery articles and unrelated retailers. No source confirms the business's own battery reconditioning or solar services.

items.description:
Berg Projects is a home maintenance and construction company based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, with more than ten years of experience and over 200 projects completed across 50 estates. The business splits its offering into homeowner services, covering handyman work, plumbing, electrical, roofing, painting, pool maintenance and smart home installations, and sectional title services for property managers.

For body corporates and managing agents, it provides complex maintenance with common property repairs and long-term maintenance planning, home renovations including bathroom and kitchen remodelling, tiling and structural alterations, and waterproofing covering roofs, balconies and basements with damp-proofing. Property managers also get 24/7 emergency response, transparent reporting and compliance documentation. It suits homeowners and body corporates across Pretoria, Johannesburg, Centurion and Midrand who need one reliable contractor for ongoing maintenance, and the office is on Swartbaars Street in Garsfontein.

Bhekanani Building and Construction is a general building and civil construction company founded in July 2002, 100 percent black owned and managed, based on Poinsettia Street in Sinoville, Pretoria. Its commercial projects include both new steel structure fabrication and repairs and restorations, with occupied and fully operational job sites never a problem for the team, and it can plan, manage and build multi-phase jobs.

The company offers an end-to-end client experience covering seamless communication, budgeting, staffing and on-site organisation, working with architects and engineers to produce functional, eco-friendly structures. Its stated commitment is to complete every project it undertakes, with a focus on service excellence, quality and reliability that it says attracts a diverse and talented workforce. It suits commercial clients needing structural work completed on live, operational sites without disrupting business, and the business is based in Sinoville, Pretoria.

Big Save Waltloo is a branch of Big Save, a proudly South African supermarket and wholesaler that has operated since 1989, bringing affordable, quality products to communities across Gauteng and beyond. Rooted in local townships, the group describes itself as more than a retailer, aiming to deliver what it calls the Good Life through affordable prices, exceptional service and community upliftment.

The Waltloo store is one of six Big Save locations, alongside Hammanskraal, Silverton, Mabopane, Tshwane Market and Marble Hall, and customers can join the Big Save Stokvel programme, which has grown to nearly 7,000 groups and over 35,000 members across the group, to save throughout the year ahead of the festive season. Orders placed before 4pm on weekdays are delivered the next day, with no deliveries on weekends or public holidays, and customers can pay by card, instant EFT or cash on collection. It suits households in Waltloo and the wider Tshwane area who want bulk groceries, fresh produce, toiletries and liquor at affordable prices, with the store on Zasm Street.

Body Fuel Express Rooihuiskraal is a water refill and beverage kiosk at Rooihuiskraal Shopping Centre in Centurion, part of the Body Fuel Express chain. The kiosk offers reverse-osmosis purified water refills and containers alongside juice, slush puppies, frozen yoghurt, ice cream, coffee, biltong, braai spices and ice lollies.

The branch has built a local following of more than 800 followers on social media, where customers can message the store directly with questions or orders. It suits residents picking up drinking water refills on a grocery run, as well as anyone after a quick treat such as frozen yoghurt or a slush puppy, and the kiosk is at Hofsanger Road in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion.

Booysen Accountants is a registered accounting, taxation and payroll practice founded in 2011, with offices in Pretoria, Gauteng, Greytown in KwaZulu-Natal, and Jacobs Bay in the Western Cape. The firm uses modern, digitally transformed systems to deliver a comprehensive business solution tailored to each client's professional accounting needs, aiming to build strong, lasting relationships that help clients achieve their business objectives with confidence.

Its services span monthly accounting, cloud accounting system implementation, tax planning and business valuations, combining an entrepreneurial approach with strategic experience to provide innovative, cost-effective solutions. The firm's internal standards include returning a client's call, email or SMS within 24 hours and sticking to agreed deadlines. It suits businesses that want a modern, technology-driven accounting partner with a personal touch, and the Gauteng office is at Midlands Office Park West in Midstream Estate, Centurion.

Botes Land Surveyors is a team of experienced professional land and engineering surveyors based in Pretoria East, specialising in construction, engineering and 3D laser scanning across Gauteng. Its services include construction project setting out, as-built surveys, 3D laser scanning, BIM modelling, cadastral property and boundary surveys, civil setting out, topographical surveys, and fixed-wing LIDAR and drone mapping.

The firm is committed to delivering high-accuracy results for high-rise developments and infrastructure projects, ensuring that all setting out is done within the specifications set by architects, engineers and municipalities. Beyond Gauteng, it regularly undertakes projects in South Africa's northern provinces, with a reputation built on the integrity of its measurements. It suits architects, engineers, developers and municipalities that need accurate surveying and 3D scanning for construction and infrastructure projects, and the firm is based on Bates Road in Moreleta Park.

Botha Bezuidenhout Attorneys Inc. is a law firm in Val-de-Grace, Pretoria, established in 2015 when its founders set out to build a legal practice that serves clients differently to the old ways of practising law, which they saw as ineffective, expensive, time-consuming and impersonal. The firm now ranks among the top law firms in Pretoria, providing personalised and affordable legal services and solutions focused on each client's needs.

Its attorneys have experience across most fields of law, specialising in civil litigation, corporate law, commercial law, consumer protection law, dispute resolution and labour law, alongside general legal services. While based in Pretoria, the firm uses modern technology and proprietary systems to serve clients from all over the country, aiming to resolve matters as quickly and efficiently as possible. It suits businesses and individuals who want personalised legal representation without the traditional law firm overhead, and the office is on the second floor of HB Forum on Stamvrug Street.

Box-It Pretoria East is a packaging and storage supplier based in Moreleta Park, Pretoria, offering moving boxes, document storage boxes, bubble wrap, packing tape, bin boxes, meat and poultry boxes, wooden crates and pallets. The business positions itself as the leading supplier of boxes in Pretoria East, serving customers who are moving house, storing important documents or shipping delicate items.

Its product range includes curated moving box kits designed to make packing as seamless and stress-free as possible, alongside stand-out items such as enviro corrugated bubble wrap, a wardrobe hanger box with rail, and a dedicated bicycle box for shipping bikes safely. The company says it is constantly innovating its box and packing supply designs to give customers exceptional value and convenience. It suits households planning a move and businesses that need reliable packaging or storage boxes, and the business is on Rubenstein Drive in Moreleta Park.

Bradlows Pretoria Central is a furniture and appliance store on Central Street in the Pretoria CBD, part of the Bradlows furniture retail chain that has connected South Africans with their favourite lounge, bedroom, dining and kitchen furnishings for generations. The store offers in-store shopping, in-store pickup and delivery, and customers can apply for store credit to finance larger purchases.

The branch is one of several Bradlows stores across Pretoria and Centurion, including locations at Sammy Marks, Wonderpark and Centurion Mall, giving shoppers several nearby options if a particular item is out of stock at this branch. It suits households furnishing a home who want to browse living room, bedroom, dining and electronics ranges in person before buying, and the store is at Shop 5, Central Street House, 223 Central Street, Pretoria.

BRAND et al is the lead agency of the et al GROUP, a Level 1 B-BBEE marketing and consultancy network based in South Africa, comprising two lead consultancy agencies and 13 specialist hubs with a group staff complement of over 180 people. The group describes itself as an intellectual rendezvous for all its approved members, with each one delivering a specialised function across the greater marketing mix.

The et al GROUP's offering spans the entire marketing spectrum, with affiliated members positioned as intellectual leaders in their respective fields. Its stated vision is to position specialisation as the apex of marketing, demonstrating the ability to integrate disparate disciplines into strategic marketing solutions that support clients' continued success. It suits businesses that want access to a network of specialist marketing agencies working together under one strategic umbrella, and BRAND et al is based at Boardwalk Boulevard in Valley Farm, Pretoria.

Bras Trucking is a logistics and freight transport company based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, renowned for personalised quality service at affordable rates. The company operates a large fleet including tri-axles, super-link flat-decks, tautliners, side-tippers and tankers, with a dedicated team managing operations to meet clients' logistical requirements with the highest quality standards.

Alongside its trucking operation, the business runs Bras Parts, which offers a vast array of authentic new and used DAF and ERF truck parts to the public through a motivated sales team focused on value for money. The business places high value on its internal work environment, giving staff opportunities to grow their skills and meet their professional goals, which supports the quality of service clients receive. It suits freight clients who need reliable, personalised logistics as well as truck owners sourcing genuine DAF and ERF parts, and the company operates from Dewar Street in Derdepoort.

Brick3D, now trading as Vector CNC, is a Pretoria-based specialist in CNC machining and 3D manufacturing, based in Zwavelpoort. The business designs and sells CNC machines and components, including spindle motors, VFDs, chillers, brackets and a range of endmills from single-flute and three-flute to compression, roughing and ball endmills.

Its machines use precision-machined parts throughout, with linear rails mounted to a flat surface to ensure accurate axis movement and a longer service life for linear bearings and ballscrews. The Dimitri CNC model uses ballscrew-driven axes on all axes, including dual ballscrews on the Y-axis with independent homing of both motors to keep the Y-axis perpendicular to the X-axis, and direct-drive couplings that minimise backlash. The electronics sit in a full metal enclosure with a filtered air input, letting the machine run in dusty industrial settings. It suits hobbyists and small manufacturers who want a precision CNC machine or components, with online ordering and appointment-based collection in Zwavelpoort.

Bushbaby Communication is a creative services and event management company based in Sable Hills Waterfront Estate, Pretoria, with a portfolio spanning corporate communications, event management, photography and videography. Its work has included coverage of the Tomorrow's Leaders Convention, the African Capital Cities Sustainability Forum, culture and Africa Day celebrations, and behind-the-scenes documentation for organisations such as the City of Tshwane and the City of Johannesburg.

The company's portfolio also extends into unexpected settings, including operating theatre photography for an animal hospital and documenting a parachute jump for the SA Army, showing a range that runs from civic events to specialist, access-restricted assignments. It suits municipalities, government departments and corporate clients who need a single creative partner for events, communications and visual documentation, and the business is based at Bushbaby Road in Sable Hills Waterfront Estate.

Business Growth Marketing Group is a digital marketing agency based in Wierdapark, Centurion, founded by a husband-and-wife team with experience supporting enterprise brands. The agency helps small and medium-sized businesses across Gauteng and the Western Cape grow through strategic digital marketing, including local SEO, high-performing website design and results-driven campaigns.

Every strategy starts with understanding a client's business, customers and local market, rather than applying the same solution to every client, and recommendations are backed by research, real data and a clear growth plan. Services include reputation management to build customer trust through stronger online reviews, content marketing that strengthens SEO and builds authority, and custom website design that is fast, mobile-friendly and built with SEO basics from the start. It suits small and medium businesses in Gauteng or the Western Cape that want long-term, locally focused marketing results over quick fixes, and the agency is on Theuns van Niekerk Street in Wierdapark.

items.description:
Caileb Construction is a road construction and maintenance company established in 2014, based in Amandasig, Akasia, focused on specialised road maintenance services, road rehabilitation and the supply and application of various bituminous road binders within South Africa. As a Qualifying Small Enterprise supplying services to main contractors in the roads industry, the company has grown through a diverse set of capabilities built on its employees' years of civil construction and manufacturing experience.

Its services include road rehabilitation and construction, asphalt surfacing, slurry, single and double seals and cape seals, milling, crack sealing, pothole repair and asphalt rejuvenation, alongside broader construction work such as layer works, road marking, gabions, concrete side drains and stone pitching. The company also manufactures and supplies asphalt cold-mix and bituminous road materials. It suits main contractors and public bodies that need a 100 percent black-owned, Level 1 BEE road maintenance partner, and the company is based on Brits Road in Akasia.

items.reason: Own site returned only a generic landing page and a Wikipedia summary of the national chain's history. No branch-specific facts for the Wonderpark Shopping Centre store were retrieved.

items.description:
Car Inspection is an independent pre-purchase vehicle inspection service based in Montana, Pretoria, sending a qualified mechanic to any location so buyers can have a used car checked before they commit to a purchase. The process runs in three steps: a customer completes a booking form, the company arranges the inspection directly with the dealership, Auto Trader listing or private seller, and sends its technician, so the buyer does not even need to be present.

The inspection covers mechanical, structural and safety components, and once complete the customer receives both a vehicle verification and a detailed 150-point mechanical report, along with a phone call giving direct feedback from the mechanic. Customers only pay once the inspection has been done, removing the risk of paying upfront for a service that has not yet delivered answers. It suits anyone buying a used car from a dealer, Auto Trader listing or private seller who wants an independent mechanical opinion first, and the business operates from Factory 30 in Wolmaranspoort, Montana.

Castor & Ladder, based in Hennopspark, Centurion, was founded in the 1960s and is a fully owned subsidiary of Argent Industrial Limited. The company is a leading manufacturer of aluminium access equipment such as scaffolding, ladders, fibreglass ladders and trolleys, along with steel storage equipment including lockers, steel cabinets, racking and shelving units, steel beds, canteen units, steel folding tables and steel cupboards, and it also distributes castors and wheels.

The business carries on the heritage of ladder brands Forlezer and Aldek, and its products extend to railyard speed control retarder systems alongside its core ladder and storage ranges. Its dedicated team works to continually improve its product innovations, and the company caters to both retailers and wholesalers rather than selling only direct to the public. It suits businesses needing access equipment, steel storage or castors and wheels in bulk, and the company is based on Jakaranda Street in Hennopspark.

Chantel Van Heerden Incorporated is a dynamic law firm established in March 2011 and located in Pretoria East, rendering a cost-effective professional service across multiple legal disciplines. The firm's vision is to make professional legal services accessible to all, with a mission to give clients personal attention and attend to each matter on an urgent basis.

Its services cover antenuptial and postnuptial agreements, cost-effective divorces, conveyancing and other family law matters, and the firm has published articles on topics such as eviction proceedings relating to residential properties. With more than ten years of experience and extensive knowledge covering notarial deeds, foreclosures, corporate recoveries, insurance claims, and family and matrimonial matters, the firm's attorney also has right of appearance in the High Court. It suits individuals and businesses needing family law, conveyancing or civil litigation handled quickly and affordably, and the office is on Marlin Street in Garsfontein.

Checkers Irene Link opened in 2022 as the group's seventh store in Centurion, based in the newly developed Irene Link Mall in Doringkloof and creating around 95 new jobs at launch. The store offers a bakery, deli, fresh produce, a salad bar and prepared meals alongside everyday groceries, giving shoppers in the area a full-service supermarket close to home.

As part of the wider Checkers chain, the store benefits from the group's established supply chain and private-label ranges, while its fresh food counters and prepared meals cater to shoppers looking for a quicker weeknight option alongside their regular grocery shop. It suits households in Doringkloof and the surrounding Centurion suburbs who want a full-range supermarket with fresh food counters close to home, and the store is on Alexandra Road in Irene Link.

Ciber Consulting is an independent technology and programme advisory firm based in Pretoria, helping African public institutions move complex, national-scale technology programmes from policy and procurement into secure, sustainable operation. The firm brings more than 30 years of specialist experience and has delivered work in nine African countries, managing programme value of more than USD 130 million.

Its core expertise covers integrated information systems, including strategy, architecture and delivery assurance for connected national registers and service channels, licensing and registration systems for driver licensing and motor vehicle registration, and secure identity and credentials work covering high-security feature selection, AFIS and de-duplication and chain-of-custody assurance. The firm defines clear requirements, strengthens procurement, supervises implementation and helps institutions build the capability to run systems well after go-live. It suits African government departments and public institutions running large national technology programmes, and the firm is based in Pretorius Park, Pretoria.

CIC Cleaning Services offers professional residential and commercial cleaning near Moregloed, Pretoria, with work guided by professionalism and a customer-focused mindset. The business started out in 2023 as a mobile car wash before rebranding to cleaning services in 2024, and it now focuses on window and gutter cleaning alongside end-of-tenancy and once-off cleans for local households and businesses.

Its hours run seven days a week, from 7am to 6pm on weekdays, 7am to 4pm on Saturdays and 7am to 2pm on Sundays, giving clients flexibility to book a clean around their own schedule. Clients value the company's responsive and straightforward approach, and many continue to work with the business based on positive past experiences. It suits homeowners and tenants in Moregloed who need a reliable local cleaner for move-out cleans or regular upkeep, and the business is on Ben Swart Street in Moregloed.

CIPC Registrations is an independent guidance platform operated by BusinessNeeds (Pty) Ltd, helping clients navigate company registration, amendment and compliance processes handled by the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission. Its services include guidance on registering and amending a company, beneficial ownership declarations, annual returns, BEE affidavit certificates, certificates of disclosure, COID services and trust registration.

Beyond CIPC compliance, the platform assists with opening an FNB business bank account and setting up a website, logo, domain and hosting package, giving a new business several administrative needs handled in one place. It also offers tender packages that bundle company registration with a BEE certificate, tax clearance, Compensation Fund registration and a letter of good standing. It suits entrepreneurs and small businesses that want guided support through CIPC registration and related compliance rather than navigating the process alone, and the business operates from Magalieskruin, Pretoria.

CIRC, short for Corporate Industrial and Risk Consultants, is a Monument Park-based firm with more than 15 years of experience handling Compensation Fund and Workmen's Compensation administration for employers across South Africa. Its services include registration under the COID Act, letters of good standing, return of earnings, household or domestic employer registration, Rand Mutual Assurance matters, and the registration and management of injury-on-duty claims.

The company says its experts understand the operating systems used by the Compensation Fund and can streamline a client's account in a short space of time, saving employers from the time-consuming process of handling these obligations themselves. It operates across the entire Republic of South Africa, with a live chat and online form available for clients who have trouble reaching the business by phone. It suits employers who need COID compliance, letters of good standing or injury claims managed by specialists, and the firm is based on Steenbok Avenue in Monument Park.

City Logistics is a privately owned Southern African supply chain company established in 1988, with this depot based in Louwlardia, Centurion. Supported by more than 1,200 vehicles and a team of over 3,000 employees, the company says it achieves a 97 percent service efficiency across the retail, automotive, FMCG and industrial sectors.

Its offering covers first-mile and last-mile transport, dedicated transport solutions, e-commerce delivery and custom solution design, backed by its own technology and innovation for tracking and managing deliveries. The company also operates subsidiary brands Fastway Couriers and AGX International Logistics, broadening its reach across courier and international logistics work. It suits retailers, manufacturers and e-commerce businesses across Southern Africa that need first- and last-mile delivery at scale, and the Centurion depot is on Olievenhoutbosch Road in Louwlardia.

Clevercom is a technology company in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, established in 2015 and built to bridge the gap between complex technology and practical business solutions. Its software development work covers custom web applications, CRM and ERP systems, process automation and database design, while its telephony offering spans WebRTC solutions, on-premise and cloud-based PBX systems and call centre solutions.

The company also runs SMS and USSD services, including bulk SMS campaigns, two-way SMS communication and USSD application development with delivery reports and analytics, plus system integration through API development and hardware provisioning of enterprise-grade routers, servers and networking equipment. Since its founding, the business has grown from a small team of passionate technologists into a trusted partner for businesses across various industries. It suits businesses that need custom software, business phone systems or messaging tools from a single technology partner, and the company is on Jerome Road in Lynnwood Glen.

Clicks Lyttelton 2 is a branch of the Clicks health and beauty retail chain, located in Lyttelton Shopping Centre on the corner of Cantonments Road and Botha Avenue, Lyttelton Manor, Centurion. The store is described as cozy and well-stocked, offering cosmetics, beauty products, vitamins and supplements, with friendly staff providing expert help for health and beauty needs in a welcoming atmosphere.

Shoppers can buy in-store or use in-store pickup and delivery for off-site orders, with payment options including NFC mobile payments, credit and debit cards, and the store offers a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking lot for customers who need it. It suits residents of Lyttelton Manor looking for everyday health, beauty and wellness products close to home, with convenient pickup or delivery options for online orders.

Clinigen South Africa is part of Clinigen Limited, a rapidly growing global speciality pharmaceutical and services company, with its South African office at Route 21 Corporate Park in Irene, Pretoria. The company focuses on specialist pharmaceutical products and medical devices, with a range that consists of both proprietary and in-licensed products.

Operating globally, Clinigen's mission is to market a vitally important and unique range of specialist products that enhance the well-being of thousands of people, connecting patients with innovative therapies that give them access to the latest treatment breakthroughs. While continuing to develop and acquire its own products, the company is also committed to building lasting relationships with partner companies around the world, operating under brands including Equity Pharmaceuticals and Equity Medical Technologies. It suits healthcare providers and patients seeking access to specialist or hard-to-find medicines and devices, and the office is at Sovereign Road, Route 21 Corporate Park.

Compensation Relief was incorporated in 2004 with the objective of providing a complete service relating to the Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, previously known as the Workmen's Compensation Act, based in Waverley, Pretoria. The company's focus is helping clients, including medical practices and other organisations, comply with this legislation, which it positions as a corporate governance priority rather than a side task.

With proactive, hands-on management, the company aims to provide an improved service with a quicker response time and close attention to detail, which it says has built client loyalty evident in a client base that includes many customers retained since the business began. Its argument to medical practices is that recovering occupational injury and disease fees is not their core business, so it makes sense to outsource the function to a specialist. It suits medical practices and other organisations that want COID compliance and claims handled by a dedicated outside team, and the business operates from Cunningham Avenue in Waverley.

Computer Swop and Repairs is a Villieria, Pretoria-based IT company that buys and sells new and pre-owned computer hardware, software and consumables, with a range of products and pre-owned laptops and desktops to fit different budgets. The business builds lasting relationships with clients based on its expert knowledge, rather than treating them as one-off customers.

Its services include technical support available by phone or email, on-site technical support for businesses in the area, and insurance assessments for devices damaged by issues such as an electrical surge. The company also promotes sustainable, responsible shopping through its electronic waste disposal service, helping customers dispose of old equipment responsibly. It suits individuals and businesses looking for affordable computer hardware, repairs or on-site IT support, and the business is on Ben Swart Street in Villieria.

CSM Engineering is a steel manufacturing and installation specialist based in Hennopspark, Centurion, with 22 years in the market and 19 employees. The company specialises in manufacturing steel, mild steel and stainless steel projects and on-site installations, offering accurate machining including milling, turning and CNC work, material binding, and welding using CO2, TIG and MIG processes.

Its further capabilities include fabrications and accurate machine drilling, sprocket and key cutting, and thread cutting and knurling, handling both once-off jobs and large-quantity fabrication runs. The company also distributes Festo and SMC pneumatic products, and its operations and clients extend beyond South Africa into Botswana, Mozambique, Swaziland and Namibia, although its main client base remains in Gauteng. It suits manufacturers and engineering clients across the region who need precision steel fabrication or pneumatic components from one supplier, and the business is at Jakaranda Park in Hennopspark.

items.description:
Dela Plast is a proudly South African plastic injection moulding company based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, specialising in the manufacture of high-quality plastic products. Its purpose-built facility designs and produces custom-moulded plastic components for clients across diverse industries, from agricultural and engineering parts to specialised medical and pharmaceutical products, through its professional contract moulding service.

The factory operates in full accordance with FSSC 22000 standards, ensuring clean, safe, high-quality plastic products that meet strict industry requirements. Beyond contract manufacturing, Dela Plast supplies its own wholesale range, including storage shelf bins, agricultural items such as tomato hooks, seed trays and its own Dela Misters, and it welcomes resellers interested in distributing these products. It suits manufacturers needing custom plastic components made to exact specifications, as well as resellers wanting to stock its wholesale product range, and the factory is on Eland Street in Koedoespoort.

Delitech is an IT services and connectivity provider based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, serving Centurion and Pretoria East with fast computer repairs, proactive business IT support and reliable network troubleshooting. Customers can drop a faulty device at the workshop without an appointment, or book an on-site technician for immediate workplace or home-office support.

For connected homes and remote professionals, Delitech diagnoses whether connection problems come from the fibre line or the home Wi-Fi, handles software and security work such as Microsoft 365 licence renewals and malware removal, and repairs broken screens, failing hard drives and power issues with rapid one-to-three day workshop diagnostics. For local businesses, it offers managed IT support with proactive remote server monitoring, cloud-based data backups and priority desktop troubleshooting, alongside fibre and LTE internet packages, web design, hosting and domain registration. It suits homes, churches, non-profits and small to medium businesses across Centurion and Pretoria East that need dependable IT support, and the shop is at Ryneveld Lifestyle Centre on Van Ryneveld Avenue.

Digital 4 Jesus is a Pretoria-based digital marketing and business systems agency in Murrayfield, connecting marketing work directly to the team that handles each enquiry. Its services are grouped around four needs: getting found by the right customers through Google Ads and SEO, turning visits into enquiries through website design and conversion-focused UX training, keeping enquiries moving through CRM automation and practical AI systems, and building a team's skills through consulting, training and social media training.

The agency's client work spans retail, healthcare, community service and automation projects, including connecting an application journey and a document-verification AI agent to a client's CRM with a clear route for staff review. Each relationship is built around the specific customer journey and responsibilities behind that business, rather than a one-size-fits-all campaign. It suits South African businesses that want their marketing, website and CRM working as one connected system, and the agency is on Camellia Avenue in Murrayfield.

Doorstuds, trading online as Noweld Ornaments, is a South African retailer of decorative door hardware based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria. The range covers round and square decorative studs, mock hinges, handles, knockers, shields, grilles, lock plates and accessories, designed for use on both the interior and exterior of a home.

Products are simple to install and maintenance free, letting customers customise furniture, doors, kitchens and cupboards with items such as coach bolt heads, round caps, pyramid caps, square knocker kits and decorative door grilles. An installation guide and gallery on the site help customers see how each piece can be used before ordering, and the business ships nationwide. It suits homeowners and renovators looking to add a decorative, hardware-based finish to doors and furniture, and the business operates from Gemsbok Street in Koedoespoort Industrial.

EasyFlo is a South African software company based in Akasia, describing itself as the country's only single integrated software solution for HR and operations management. The system brings together modules for employees, HR administration, site management and debtors, roster scheduling, payroll and legal compliance, standard labour forms, stock and logistics per site and employee, time and attendance, and vehicle management, all within one integrated data set.

The company says its approach avoids the duplication, complexity and high costs that come from running many separate systems, offering instead one simplified platform with one price. EasyFlo is available across server, web and mobile platforms, with new versions released monthly at no extra cost, and its licence fees are based on the number of employees a business manages. It suits businesses that want payroll, rostering, stock and vehicle management unified in a single system rather than juggling several tools, and the company is on Lilac Street in Amandasig, Akasia.

ECU-Warehouse sells, supports and installs engine management systems from its Wonderboom South store, operating both online and as a walk-in shop, and describes itself as the home of engine management systems in South Africa. The company is an authorised dealer of all South African-manufactured engine management systems and offers support throughout the installation process as well as after-sales service.

An engine management system, or ECU, is a universal engine control unit that can be used to start and run most petrol engines, and the company's site explains what the units do for customers unfamiliar with the technology. Orders over R2,000 are delivered for free, with a same-day delivery option for local orders, and customers can also collect in person and pay by card at the walk-in store. It suits car owners and tuners who need an engine management system sourced, supported and installed by an authorised dealer, and the shop is on 14th Avenue in Wonderboom South.

Edladleni Trading and Projects is a multi-service provider based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, that started operations in 2012 with a CIDB 1GB PE contractor grading. The company offers construction, logistics and information technology services, priding itself on good quality facilities and the ability to deliver in a timeous fashion.

As an owner-managed business with strong leadership, the company says it provides flexible and personal service, backed by an experienced team that has built up knowledge of the industry over the years. It positions itself as competitive in the market while keeping quality as its top priority, aiming to meet or exceed client expectations on every project. It suits clients who need building construction, renovations, extensions or general contracting handled by a locally graded contractor, and the company is based at Neptune Building on Landmarks Avenue in Kosmosdal.

Elma's is a family restaurant in Mayville Mall, Pretoria, with a history stretching back to November 1992, when its founder established a BJ's franchise on the site while still walking amongst building rubble during the original shop's construction. Fifteen years later, in 2007, the restaurant was rebranded as Elma's to offer customers a better level of service, and it has traded continuously ever since.

The restaurant's menu spans international comfort food, including mac and cheese, chicken and ribs, and waffles, served in line with the business's founding principles of value for money, good service and quality products in a clean, friendly environment. After more than three decades in the restaurant business, the team draws on that experience to live up to its motto, "more to enjoy". It suits families and regulars looking for a long-standing, dependable restaurant with a varied comfort-food menu, and the restaurant is at Van Rensburg Street in Mayville.

Enbiosis SA is a B2B platform based at Alenti Office Park in The Willows, Pretoria, bringing AI-powered gut microbiome analysis to South Africa through whole-genome sequencing, artificial intelligence and clinical data. The platform builds personalised nutrition and supplement plans, including personalised probiotics and microbiome analysis services, designed to actively modulate the gut microbiome and restore key functions.

Its technology is backed by peer-reviewed studies, including research published in the American Journal of Gastroenterology comparing Enbiosis's diet to an elimination diet, which found reduced symptoms and increased microbiome diversity, and a pilot study in Gut Microbes covering 25 IBS patients that recorded a 124-point drop in symptom score. A further study in the Journal of Clinical Medicine found that 84 percent of 45 adults with chronic constipation achieved three or more bowel movements a week within six weeks. It suits healthcare practitioners and pharmacies who want to offer patients clinically validated, personalised gut-health insights, with practitioners able to find or become a partner through the platform.

Foto Discount World is a camera and photographic equipment retailer in Montana Park, Pretoria, trading since 2003 as an authorised dealer for brands including Fujifilm, Nikon, OM System, Sigma, Canon and SanDisk. The shop sells DSLRs, mirrorless cameras, lenses, flashes, camcorders, binoculars, rangefinders, studio lights, drones, tripods, camera bags, memory cards and lens filters, both online and in person.

Purchases come with a two-year local warranty and a 30-day return window, backed by expert advice from staff and free delivery to the customer's door. The shop also handles onsite repairs, giving local photographers a nearby option for servicing existing equipment rather than sending it away. It suits hobbyist and professional photographers in Pretoria who want genuine, warrantied camera equipment and repairs from a long-established local dealer, and the shop is on Breed Street in Montana Park.

The Foundation for Professional Development is a Pretoria-based training and capacity-development organisation that has equipped health professionals, leaders and institutions across Africa and beyond for nearly 30 years. It has been registered with the Department of Higher Education and Training, SAQA and the Council on Higher Education since 2002, and counts more than 607,500 alumni across over 110 countries.

Its School of Health Sciences trains healthcare professionals through formal registered qualifications and short courses, including rapid CPD compliance options that keep practitioners' continuing professional development points up to date and aligned with Health Professions Council of South Africa requirements. The organisation also runs graduate learning programmes, conferences and webinars, and research covering clinical trials, STI research and HIV research, with more than 90 percent of alumni saying they would recommend it to peers. It suits healthcare professionals and institutions across Africa seeking accredited qualifications, short courses or research partnerships, and the organisation is based on Mary Road in Die Wilgers.

Garment Care SA is a textile care chemical manufacturer and consultant based in Icon Industrial Park, Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, supplying laundry detergents, laundry chemicals, dry-cleaning and spotting products, and finishing supplies to the dry-cleaning and laundry trade. Its dry-cleaning range includes perchloroethylene stabilised to dry-cleaning grade and imported from Europe, alongside auxiliaries such as lint roller refills and bio power laundry detergent sold in 25 kilogram quantities.

The company also stocks finishing and packaging accessories including brown paper, pvc-coated hangers supplied 500 to a box, iron board covers, suit covers, sanitary bin bags and plastic bags and rolls in several sizes. Deliveries run daily within Gauteng, with a minimum order of R2,000, and once a month to Limpopo, KwaZulu-Natal, the Free State, North West, Mpumalanga and the Northern Cape. It suits dry cleaners and laundries across South Africa and neighbouring countries that need chemicals, detergents and packaging supplies from a specialist manufacturer, and the business is on Kwanbi Crescent in Sunderland Ridge.

Gecko Ridge Wedding Venue is a wedding and function venue on the banks of the Pienaars River near Mooiplaas, offering chapels and banquet halls that accommodate between 20 and 600 guests. Beyond weddings, the venue hosts conferences, team building, product launches, brand awareness events, year-end functions, matric farewells, parties and birthday celebrations, with on-site accommodation available for guests who want to stay over.

The venue also runs food-tasting events open to the public, giving couples the chance to meet and discuss requirements with the venue's industry suppliers while sampling the food on offer, which reviewers describe as being on another level. Past clients have praised the team for going out of their way to help and accommodate any request, alongside the venue's beautiful setting and attentive service. It suits couples and event organisers looking for a riverside venue that can scale from an intimate gathering to a large banquet, and the venue is on Gecko Ridge Road in Mooiplaas.

Gigi's Furniture Removals has been moving homes and offices in Pretoria, Johannesburg and Cape Town for 60 years, servicing the entire Gauteng and Western Cape areas from its branch in Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria. The company offers private storage and packing services, using closed-body vehicles that protect furniture and belongings from the weather during transit.

Every move includes R150,000 of goods-in-transit insurance as standard, and the company says it will never cut corners or apply hidden costs, aiming to keep removals affordable while maintaining a professional standard of service. Client privacy is treated seriously, with new addresses, phone numbers, furniture lists and removal dates kept confidential and never disclosed to a third party without a valid court order. It suits households and offices moving within Gauteng, to Cape Town, or further afield who want an experienced, insured removals company, and the Pretoria branch is on Brander Street in Jan Niemand Park.
